clue.text: An awful crisis when bloomers were made

indicators.note: an awful mess suggests the letters of the words around it are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone recalls the dreadful emergency when their knickers were made.
explanation.walkthrough: 'awful' rearranges AN plus CRISIS. 'bloomers' looks like old-fashioned underwear but means flowers, things that bloom.
explanation.definitionFit: Daffodil-like spring flowers are plants that bloom, so they are bloomers.

clue.text: Figure that an anaesthetic will be needed

explanation.surface: A surgeon calculates how much painkiller is needed.
explanation.definitionFit: A digit is a figure; read as numb-er, it is also a thing that deadens feeling, like an anaesthetic.

clue.text: Go at great speed in the deciding race

explanation.surface: A sprinter speeds through a decider.
explanation.definitionFit: To flee quickly is to run off; a final contest to settle a tie is a run-off.

clue.text: Take a risk in getting a dog…

parts.note: a cur is a mongrel dog

explanation.surface: Getting a dog is a gamble.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis runs on to the next clue, which continues the dog's story.
explanation.definitionFit: To bring something on oneself, such as a danger, is to run or take it.

clue.text: … which might be disreputable

parts.note: follows on from the dog of the previous clue: a mongrel of that sort might look shabby and unkempt

explanation.surface: The dog just acquired may look unsavoury.
explanation.walkthrough: The leading dots link this to the previous clue's dog.
explanation.definitionFit: Shabby and untidy in appearance suggests a dubious, disreputable look.

clue.text: Consents to take notes when one who can tell returns

indicators.note: returns says the word for a prophet is read backwards

parts.note: a seer can tell the future

explanation.surface: Someone agrees to take music lessons when a fortune teller comes back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one who can tell' is a fortune teller, the sense of telling the future rather than telling tales.
explanation.definitionFit: To consent is to say yes, to be of one mind with another.

clue.text: The inexperienced take note of the elderly when choosing fruit

parts.note: age stands for the old, the elderly

explanation.surface: Young and old pick fruit at an orchard.
explanation.definitionFit: A greengage is a kind of green plum.

clue.text: The plane crash involved a large animal

indicators.note: crash suggests the letters are smashed up and reassembled

explanation.surface: An air crash involving a big beast.
explanation.definitionFit: The biggest land mammal, with trunk and tusks, is a large animal.

clue.text: Cut up about a young mischief maker who went fishing

indicators.note: about places the cutting word around the mischief maker

parts.note: to shred is to cut up
an imp is a mischievous child

explanation.surface: A naughty child tears things up then goes off angling.
explanation.definitionFit: To catch small crustaceans with a net is to go fishing for them.

clue.text: Person I heal when I treat his hands

explanation.surface: A healer describes tending a patient's hands.
explanation.definitionFit: A manicure is a beauty treatment for the fingernails and hands; here it is used as a verb.

clue.text: Facing a change of direction about a couple of points

indicators.note: about means the change of direction goes around the pair of compass points

parts.note: to veer is to change direction
N and E are two compass points, north and east

explanation.surface: A ship or walker turns slightly between two compass bearings.
explanation.definitionFit: A thin decorative surface layer of wood is a facing over cheaper material.

clue.text: The fool ought to have been left in bed!

indicators.note: in puts the letter for left within the word for a bed

explanation.surface: Someone foolish should have stayed in bed.
explanation.definitionFit: A clot is British slang for a dimwit or fool.

clue.text: Struggling, tore fluff out

indicators.note: out suggests the letters are put out of their order and rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone tugs fluff from a cushion with difficulty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges the letters of TORE FLUFF.
explanation.definitionFit: Labouring and strained, needing much exertion, describes something done while struggling.

clue.text: Minor prophet who set part of Smyrna humming

indicators.note: part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A Biblical seer gets a Turkish port buzzing.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is only 'Minor prophet'; 'who set' is a link, so the draft's longer definition was trimmed. Smyrna is the old name for Izmir in Turkey.
explanation.definitionFit: Nahum is one of the twelve short Old Testament books named after lesser seers.

clue.text: In the street it's right to be cautious

indicators.note: In places the letter for right within the word for a street

parts.note: a way is a street or road

explanation.surface: Advice to be careful when out on the road.
explanation.definitionFit: Being on one's guard against danger is being cautious.

clue.text: I'm in a race, and getting it moving!

indicators.note: in places I'M inside the other pieces

parts.note: a nation is a people or race

explanation.surface: A competitor gets excited taking part in a race.
explanation.definitionFit: Bringing pictures to life so they appear to move is animation.

clue.text: Student gets double points after using public transport

indicators.note: after puts the doubled point at the end, behind the transport

parts.note: a train is a form of public transport

indicators.note: double means the compass point is written twice

explanation.surface: A learner earns a bonus for taking the train.
explanation.definitionFit: A person learning a job is an apprentice or student.

clue.text: The worker I beat did have a disadvantage

parts.note: to cap is to beat or outdo

explanation.surface: A labourer is beaten despite having a disadvantage.
explanation.definitionFit: A hindrance or weight that makes success harder is a disadvantage.

clue.text: Greek saint who could have written a note in Tunisia

indicators.note: could have written suggests the letters might have been set down in another order

explanation.surface: A holy man who may have sent a letter from North Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'could have written' rearranges G and TUNISIA.
explanation.definitionFit: Ignatius of Antioch was an early bishop and saint of the Greek Church.

clue.text: Upset any girl and she will react thus

indicators.note: Upset signals the letters of the next two words are knocked over and rearranged

explanation.surface: Annoy a young woman and expect a cross reply.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Upset' rearranges ANY GIRL. 'thus' stands for the manner of the reaction, an adverb.
explanation.definitionFit: The adverb describes the cross way an upset person behaves, so 'thus' in context means in a cross manner.

clue.text: American tug

explanation.definitionFit: A Yankee is informal for someone from the USA; to yank is to pull sharply.

clue.text: Type of leaf hopper

indicators.note: Type of suggests a different form or arrangement of the word that follows

parts.note: taken as written; the run across 'of leaf' also spells the insect, but that is a coincidence, as nothing signals a hidden word

explanation.surface: A leaf hopper is an insect, so the clue looks like naming one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Type of' rearranges LEAF. Leafhoppers are real insects, which hides the split.
explanation.definitionFit: A small jumping insect parasite is a creature that hops.

clue.text: Argue about unwanted radiation

explanation.surface: A quarrel about nuclear contamination.
explanation.definitionFit: To fall out is to quarrel; fallout is radioactive dust left after a nuclear blast.

clue.text: European ticket giving admission to lodgings

explanation.surface: A pass from abroad gets someone into a place to stay.
explanation.definitionFit: Billet is French for a ticket; a billet is also soldiers' quarters, lodging.

clue.text: A University man is a good looker

parts.note: a don is a university lecturer

explanation.surface: A college lecturer is handsome.
explanation.definitionFit: Adonis, the beautiful youth of Greek myth, names any handsome man.

clue.text: She might be able to help when she gets back

indicators.note: gets back says the phrase is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: something able to help is an aid, read here as 'an aid'

explanation.surface: A woman could be useful once she returns home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gets back' turns AN AID into the name.
explanation.definitionFit: Diana is a woman's name, so a female figure, 'she'.

clue.text: Fluid Neil used cancelled the effect

indicators.note: used suggests the letters are put to new use in a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: A man called Neil applied a liquid that undid something.
explanation.definitionFit: To make something void, wiping out its force, is to cancel its effect.

clue.text: 11 described another way

parts.note: points to the answer at 11 and asks for another word with the same meaning, a dimwit

explanation.definitionFit: A fool or nitwit is a stupid person, the same as a clot.

clue.text: People rather badly treated here

parts.note: reads like a place of cruelty, but 'rather badly' means somewhat ill, so it is where unwell patients receive medical treatment

explanation.surface: A complaint about poor service somewhere.
explanation.definitionFit: A medical centre is where the sick are seen by doctors.

clue.text: Rampaging lion and colt lead to such a dance

indicators.note: Rampaging suggests wild disorder, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: Wild animals running riot lead someone a merry dance.
explanation.definitionFit: The cotillion is an old French social dance for couples.

clue.text: Having the right attitude to a puzzle

definitions.text: Having the right attitude to a puzzle

parts.words: Having the right attitude to a puzzle
parts.note: reads as being in the correct mood for a brainteaser, but means striking a pose, or setting a question

explanation.surface: Good advice for a crossword solver.
explanation.definitionFit: Adopting a posture or attitude, or putting forward a problem, both describe this word.

clue.text: When you French get in America you make laws!

indicators.note: get in places the French pronoun inside the word for America

explanation.surface: A French visitor to America becomes a lawmaker.
explanation.definitionFit: Acts passed by a legislature are written laws.
